purpose: Organic aerosol and dry-brush paint stamp. No people, lettering or flag. Composited only outside protected portrait/body/flag regions.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: real transparent-alpha PAINT ONLY texture stamp for a Hebrew memorial graffiti wall compositor. Create one organic irregular cluster of AUTHENTIC aerosol paint and dry-brush strokes on a TRULY TRANSPARENT background, with generous transparent margins. Absolutely NO wall or concrete background, NO text, NO letters, NO symbols, NO people, NO faces, NO flag, NO logo. Palette ONLY saturated cobalt blue, navy blue, sky blue, golden/sunshine yellow and light lemon yellow, with a few white paint flecks. Main form: energetic wide diagonal broad hand-brushed blue and yellow swipes intersecting loose soft aerosol clouds and naturally scattered irregular droplets. Real paint material: dense blue/yellow pigment, fine spray mist and varied splatter sizes, rough torn bristle edges, broken paint coverage and tiny dry-brush gaps, visibly textured paint, a few short natural drips. Balance broad painted masses with ragged edges and transparent gaps. THIS MUST LOOK LIKE ACTUAL SPRAY AND A WIDE ROUGH PAINTBRUSH, NOT computer vector strokes, parallel comb lines, neat straight bars, abstract logo, shiny liquid, smooth gradient ribbons or evenly spaced confetti. Dynamic street-art mural paint on invisible substrate. The transparent silhouette should taper organically in every direction with fine isolated flecks, not be cropped or rectangular. No cast shadow, no paper, no checkerboard drawn into the image. The ENTIRE image is only blue/yellow/white paint with genuine alpha transparency.
